string-array.name: task_limit_motivational_messages
string-array.item: Five quests at a time — conquer them before unlocking more.
Priority is power. Focus on the five that matter.
Discipline is choosing what to leave out. Stay at five.
Master your current trials before seeking new ones.
The hunter focuses. The prey scatters. Finish your five.
Don\'t dilute your effort. Five priorities. No more.
